items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Well I heard them, that's in my daddy time. They used to play at the Artfeller Hall... I was pretty small them days.

ctx.x: And what band was this your daddy used to listen to? Did he tell you the name of it?
Uh, no, I was small when he used to go to dances and things. He didn't tell you much about it? No, no. But you did say Robichard was back in that time? Yeah, yeah, Robichard was back in that time.
Did you ever hear him talk about Buddy Bolden?
